thread:
Anya (Support): FYI forwarding a customer ticket — ACME Corp wants streaming chat + tool-calls but with structured JSON partial outputs. They're blocked in production. Ticket: 'need partial JSON schema fields as they stream so we can update UI progressively.'
Anya (Support): attach: snippet from their engineer: `we need `on_partial` callbacks that emit validated JSON fragments; current streaming only sends plain text until final.`
Olga (Sales): This is a $$ large account (enterprise). They're asking for timeline before EOW. Can product give priority guidance?
Matt (Product): Ping engineering: is this a minor API surface change or larger SDK/runtime work? Also need launch criteria — schema validation, backward compat, docs, and examples.
Kofi (Eng): Short answer: medium. Runtime already supports chunked token streams. Main work: 1) extend streaming protocol to include structured chunks (meta frames) 2) hook into tool-calling flow so emitted tool outputs can be validated as JSON and forwarded mid-stream 3) SDK changes for convenience. Could be done as opt-in flag on /chat.stream.
Kofi (Eng): Risks: schema validation in-stream could add latency; need graceful fallback when fragments are invalid. Also security: must ensure tool outputs aren't executed client-side without auth.
Matt (Product): Proposed scope for intake: - API: add `response_mode=structured_stream` with chunk types: TEXT|STRUCT|TOOL_EVENT - SDK: helpers to reassemble structured fragments into JSON objects - Backwards compatible: default remains current behavior - Telemetry: new trace span + errors.
Anya (Support): Customer specifically requested early partial JSON to render progressive UI. They can tolerate slight latency but not >200ms token delay.
Kofi (Eng): Implementation sketch: emit frames like `{"type":"struct","id":"req123","path":"/choices/0/message","fragment":"{\"cursor\":1,\"items\":[...`}` then SDK reconstructs. We'll need streaming JSON-safe delimiting (length-prefix or newline-delimited).
Matt (Product): Acceptance criteria (draft): - AC1: Customer can opt in and receive valid JSON fragments that validate against provided schema - AC2: SDK reassembles fragments and exposes partial objects/events - AC3: No regression to existing streaming latency SLA (95th p50 within 150ms baseline) - AC4: Tests + e2e with sample tool-calls - AC5: Docs and example app.
Olga (Sales): If we can commit to a private beta in 6 weeks, they will sign a pilot contract.
Kofi (Eng): Rough estimate: 3-4 sprints for core runtime + 1 sprint for SDK and docs. If we cut scope (e.g., no in-stream schema enforcement, only framing and leave validation client-side) we can do a slim beta in 3 wks.
Matt (Product): Tradeoffs noted. Proposal: 1) Ship `structured_stream` framing first (no server validation) as beta to unblock customers. 2) Add optional server-side schema validation in later milestone. This reduces risk and latency.
Anya (Support): Customer happy to try beta without validation as long as we mark it experimental.
ci-bot: Deploy preview job queued for branch `feature/stream-frames` (CI #8421).
Matt (Product): Next steps: - Kofi to write a short spec doc + sample wire frames by EOD tomorrow - Anya to tell ACME pilot timeline - Olga to draft pilot commercial note - We'll track as ticket PROD-1487.
Kofi (Eng): Will open draft RFC and link here. ETA for draft: tomorrow lunchtime.
Olga (Sales): :thumbsup: Thanks team, I’ll update customer after we have the spec.
